title: Provider-neutral CaScanResponse v1 domain output contract
objective: Design and implement a provider-neutral, versioned, fixture-driven CaScanResponse v1 domain output contract. The contract only composes already-normalized data and judgment evidence; it does not fetch live data, implement providers, or change the current Helius-only provider boundary.
forbidden_actions: Do not call Hotsniper API or any network endpoint.
Do not add DexScreener, Birdeye, GMGN, Rugcheck, or any new provider.
Do not promote Tier-B labels to confirmed conclusions.
Do not modify wallet scoring, GMGN parser, wallet master-table builder, or the parallel repair write set (wallet-data-quality.ts, master-table-builder.ts, their tests).
Do not migrate the whole repository directory layout.
Do not introduce new dependencies or modify package.json.
Do not create API server, worker, database migration, or UI.
Do not merge, push, or commit to main without Owner authorization.
Do not modify the existing codex/solana-daily-new-token-analysis worktree.
